questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Ophelia said, "Tony, I'll give you money when you come tomorrow."
options: A. Ophelia gave money to Tony.
B. Ophelia planned to give money to Tony.
C. Ophelia promised to give money to Tony when he came the next day.
D. Ophelia suggested to give money to Tony when he came the day after.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Câu tường thuật gián tiếp “I'll give you money when you come tomorrow” → she promised to …. (hứa sẽ làm gì.) Dịch nghĩa: Ophelia hứa sẽ đưa tiền cho Tony khi anh đến vào ngày hôm sau.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Watching this channel is educational for young students.
options: A. Young learners can learn valuable lessons by watching this channel.
B. This channel is musical, therefore young learners should watch it.
C. Young students find it amusing to watch this channel.
D. Watching this channel is uninteresting for younger students.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: educational = giúp học sinh học hỏi, thu được kiến thức/giá trị. Dịch nghĩa: Học sinh có thể học những bài học bổ ích bằng cách xem kênh này.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. This story is not interesting enough for France to read.
options: A. This story is not boring enough for France to read.
B. This story is so interesting that France doesn't want to read.
C. This story is too boring for France to read.
D. This story is such an interesting one that Tommy doesn't want to read.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: not interesting enough (không đủ thú vị) ≈ too boring (quá nhàm). Dịch nghĩa: Câu chuyện này quá nhàm chán để France đọc.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Even though Fast and Furious film is frightening, young people like it.
options: A. Fast and Furious film is frightening, but young people like it.
B. Fast and Furious film is frightening because young people like it.
C. Fast and Furious film is frightening, so young people like it.
D. Fast and Furious film is frightening, for young people like it.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Câu gốc diễn đạt sự tương phản (Even though…). Đáp án A dùng but để thể hiện mối quan hệ trái ngược. Dịch nghĩa: Bộ phim Fast and Furious đáng sợ, nhưng giới trẻ vẫn thích.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. My dad has not spoken to him for five years.
options: A. My dad has often spoken to him for the last five years.
B. About five years ago, my dad used to speak to him.
C. The last time my dad spoke to him was five years ago.
D. My dad spoke to him five years ago and will never speak to him again.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc: has not + V3 for … years = lần cuối cùng làm việc đó là … năm trước. Dịch nghĩa: Lần cuối bố tôi nói chuyện với ông ấy là 5 năm trước.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. She's never had cuisine like this before.
options: A. Lot of this kind of cuisine used to be consumed by her.
B. She's accustomed to consuming this type of cuisine.
C. She has never eaten this kind of cuisine before.
D. She's had this kind of cuisine numerous times in the past.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc: has never had … before = chưa từng … trước đây. Dịch nghĩa: Cô ấy chưa bao giờ ăn loại đồ ăn này trước đây.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The novel you lent me last week attracts my curiosity greatly.
options: A. I'm glad you lent me the novel last week because it seems curious.
B. It wasn't the fascinating book you gave me last week.
C. I'm finding it too curious to read the novel you lent me last week.
D. I'm really interested in the novel you lent me last week.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: attracts my curiosity greatly = khiến tôi rất hứng thú. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi thực sự quan tâm/thích thú với cuốn tiểu thuyết mà bạn cho tôi mượn tuần trước.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Housewives don't have to dedicate a lot of time to housekeeping.
options: A. Housewives will never stop perform household chores.
B. Housewives are required to devote an increasing amount of time to cleaning.
C. Housewives have never spent more time cleaning the house than they do right now.
D. Housewives no longer have to devote a lot of time to housekeeping.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: don’t have to = không cần phải, no longer have to = không còn cần phải. Dịch nghĩa: Nội trợ không còn phải dành nhiều thời gian cho việc nhà nữa.
